title: Invoice number on a detail row navigates the current tab to the underlying work order or parts sale
permissions_required: Reports/Performance access plus permission to open the destination.
preconditions: 1. A rep row is expanded with at least one S and one P invoice visible.
steps: 1. Click a service invoice's number link and note the destination and tab.
2. Go back, then click a parts invoice's number link.
expected: 1. Each invoice number is a clickable link.
2. Activating it navigates the CURRENT tab to the underlying invoice (work order or parts sale) — never a new tab.
design_ref: none - SPEC-ONLY (Report Suite has no designs yet)
notes: Opening in a new tab (target=_blank) is explicitly listed as a defect (S12-N3).
